identity.title: ALMA observations of a metal-rich damped Ly α absorber at z = 2.5832: evidence for strong galactic winds in a galaxy group
identity.journal: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society

paper_type_evidence.quote: We report on the results of a search for CO(3-2) emission from the galaxy counterpart of a high-metallicity Damped Ly$\alpha$ Absorber (DLA) at $z=2.5832$ towards the quasar Q0918+1636.

evidence.quote: The galaxy counterpart is detected at a projected distance of 1.98 arcsec from the quasar (i.e. 16.2 kpc at $z=2.5832$).

distance_source.value: DLA absorption redshift in the quasar spectrum

evidence.quote: The galaxy counterpart is detected at a projected distance of 1.98 arcsec from the quasar (i.e. 16.2 kpc at $z=2.5832$).

question.value: Is CO(3-2) emission detected from the galaxy counterpart of the metal-rich DLA at z=2.5832 towards Q0918+1636, and what does the field reveal about the DLA's group environment and outflows?

evidence.quote: We do not detect CO emission from the previously identified DLA galaxy counterpart.
Instead we detect CO(3-2) emission from another intensely star-forming galaxy at an impact parameter of 117 kpc
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA#2016.1.00628.S (PI Prochaska).
